name: card-stack
summary: A Wallet-style stack that fans open on tap and slides the picked card to the front.
props: Render a card. `front` is true for the card in front.
How much of each card shows behind the front one when closed.
Cards visible behind the front one when closed.
Tap on the front card while closed (pay with it); the cards behind still open the stack.
Fires when a card is picked.
Fires when the stack opens or closes.
behavior: Tap the closed stack to fan it open, then tap a card to bring it to the front as the stack closes. With onPressFront, a tap on the front card calls it instead.
Cards behind the front one shrink and tilt back in 3D depth. Opening, closing and reordering all run on springs.
Each card is a button with selected and expanded state, labelled "Card 2 of 4" by default or by getAccessibilityLabel.
